title: IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity)
summary: An IMEI is a 15-digit number that uniquely identifies a mobile device. Format: TAC (8 digits, Type Allocation Code) + SNR (6 digits, Serial Number) + Check digit (1 digit, Luhn). TAC identifies the device model; SNR identifies the individual device.

notes: 15 digits (no dashes in the actual number).
TAC (Type Allocation Code): 8 digits (identifies device model).
IMEI is used for device identification, blacklisting stolen devices, and network access control.
